decisive_items: Cytological brushing of the gastric mucosa demonstrated mucosal cells, mixed neutrophilic and macrophagic inflammation, and occasional large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching
The presence of large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching in the cytological brushing of the gastric mucosa is consistent with basidiobolomycosis
response.rationale: The presence of large, non-septate hyphae with irregular diameter and branching in the cytological brushing of the gastric mucosa is more specific for basidiobolomycosis than the imaging findings for gastric neoplasia

rejected.why: Imaging findings do not support gastrointestinal foreign body
